text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hot diggity dog! What a turnout!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I head to a shrine with Yukino Bijin to welcome in the new year and pray for success in her senior year.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I guess it doesn't matter if you're in Morioka or the big city, everyone's got someth'n to pray for.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Okay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I stand next to Yukino Bijin as she clasps her hands and prays earnestly. I close my own eyes as well to wish for her happiness.
choice_data_list: (Please let Yukino Bijin's wish come true.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Now what should we do? We've got a li'l time before train'n, right?
choice_data_list: What would you like to do?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hm…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: We could eat something sweet, or maybe take a li'l stroll, or maybe do something fun…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: That's all I can think of right now. What d'you think?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: In that case, there's a parfait place I've been want'n to try!

text_block_list.name: Server
text_block_list.text: Thanks for waiting! Two seasonal Snow Rabbit Parfaits. Enjoy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The pure white parfaits the server sets down before us look like winter snowshoe hares. They even come topped with a piece of mochi shaped like a rabbit.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: H-holy mackerel!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: T-T-Trainer! L-l-look at these two cutie-patoo… cutie-patoo…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Gee whiz! What'm I supposed to do? Do I even dare t'take a bite?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh, wait! Before we dig in…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Um, could y'take a picture of me 'n' the snow rabbit?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thank you! I'll puff out m'cheeks so I look like the li'l mochi bunny!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Aaand there! Sent!
choice_data_list: Who did you send it to?
Who did you send it to?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: City!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: She was the one who told me 'bout this place. She said this parfait reminded her of me.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Folks've been say'n I remind 'em of mochi since forever ago. That's why I did my mochi face!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I hope City gets a laugh outta it!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Oh? A message from Yukino…

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Pfft… Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hey, what's so funny? You feelin' all right?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hokay, let's tuck in!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Stab!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I wince as Yukino Bijin ruthlessly stabs her fork right into the snow rabbit's head…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Sounds like a plan, Stan.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: We can take the scenic route home!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh, how about we play a li'l game while we're at it?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: The only rule is that you can't stop walk'n, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: For example, if we hit a red light, instead of wait'n to cross, we just turn the corner and keep on walk'n.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: And if we hit a dead end, we take a U-turn and keep on keep'n on!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: We don't have a lotta stoplights back in Morioka, so this is a game that only works in the city. Well? Think you've got it?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Then, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Look, Trainer! It's a red light!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Right!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Drat! Dead end!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: About face!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Yukino Bijin and I march on without stopping.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Jiminy! The view here's someth'n else!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wooow…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh, now I've done it! I've gone and stopped in my tracks!
choice_data_list: It's okay. Let's take our time and check out the scenery.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Roger that!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yukino Bijin and I take our time to take in the field of flowers we've stumbled across.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yippee!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hmm, but what can we squeeze into the time b'tween now and train'n? There's not that much time.
choice_data_list: Well, I do have one idea…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh wow! An arcade!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Good call! We can play a bit and have fun with the time we've got!
choice_data_list: What do you want to do?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Weeell, I'm basic'lly clueless when it comes t'arcade games.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I've never really played any b'fore…

text_block_list.name: High School Girl A
text_block_list.text: Hey, wanna try that dancing game? All we ever do is use the photo booths, so I wanna shake things up!

text_block_list.name: High School Girl B
text_block_list.text: Sure! Why not?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: City girls sure are carefree.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: …Oh! Actually, there is a game I wanna try!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And with that, she chooses…

text_block_list.name: Zombie
text_block_list.text: Graaaaah! Rrrgh! BRAAAINS!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Don't worry, Trainer! Yukino Bijin, to the rescuuuue!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Shing!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: We did it! We won!
choice_data_list: You didn't look scared at all…
You didn't look scared at all…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Well, no! It's just a game, y'know!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But golly, that sure was fun!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing Yukino Bijin so calm and satisfied gives me a renewed sense of admiration for her.
